lines.en: I creep along the leaf veins.

lines.zh: 腹足一下一下抓住叶面
lines.en: My prolegs grip the leaf, one by one.
I move to the edge of the leaf.
My body arches and stretches.

lines.zh: 我绕过一片被咬过的洞
lines.en: I crawl around a chewed hole.
A trail of mine crosses the leaf.
I crawl slowly, but I never stop.
The two spots on my head shift.
I grip the stem and reach down.
Another leaf is just beside this one.
I stretch out to test the gap.
I turn and keep eating.

lines.zh: 身上的横纹随身体起伏
lines.en: My bands ripple with my body.
I circle a tender shoot.
I crawl from the underside to the top.
The next meal is not far.
I rest on a vein, still.
I chew slowly, bite by bite.
My body rises and falls gently.
I press against the leaf to sun.
The leaf is curling a little.
I lift my head and look around.

lines.zh: 我吐了一点丝固定自己
lines.en: I spin a little silk to hold on.
The wind rocks the whole leaf.

lines.zh: 我的横纹在光下很清楚
lines.en: My bands show clearly in the light.
I contract my body once.
Nothing else is stirring.
I will stay right here.
You are blocking my light.
I poke half my head out from under the leaf.

lines.zh: 你比这片叶子大太多了
lines.en: You are so much bigger than this leaf.
I taste bad; I am not food.
I slowly pull my head back.
Are you going to put me in a jar?
I am eating this leaf.
Do not touch the spots on my head.
I cannot reach you.
You're blocking my sunlight.
I curl into a small ball.

lines.zh: 我掉了一片叶子的距离
lines.en: I drop the height of a leaf.
I spin silk and hang on.
One side of me will not move well.
I crawl back slowly.
Do not crush me.
I have a scrape.
I am still on the leaf.
I quiver all over once.
Let me recover a moment.
Is that a leaf?
I stretch my head that way.
The smell of fresh leaves.
I crawl toward that leaf.
This one is tenderer than the one I am on.
I know it by the smell.
Could you bring it closer?
I am hungry, truly hungry.
I will crawl over there.
Do not take the leaf away.

lines.zh: 你碰到叶子,我晃了一下
lines.en: You touched the leaf and I swayed.
I grip the leaf surface tight.
The jolt makes me curl up.
I drop a short way.
You touched it again.

lines.zh: 我在叶子背面,你撞不到
lines.en: I am under the leaf, out of your way.
This leaf is too small.
I edge away along the rim.
Do not shake this tree.
I have steadied myself.
I spin silk to draw the leaves together.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一片叶子上
lines.en: We crowd onto the same leaf.
I bring my head to yours.
This leaf can feed us both.
I feel you moving.
We crawl forward together.
Do not bite through the leaf.
I will wait here for you.
Quiet is enough.
The leaf will still be here.
I take a small bite.

lines.zh: 我只吃叶子，别的一概不碰。
lines.en: I eat only leaves and touch nothing else.
I push it; it does not move.
I crawl on top of it.
It is far bigger than I am.
I stick it down with silk.
I cannot eat this.
I crawl around it.
It blocks the middle of the path.
I push it off the leaf.
Something is shaking the leaf.
I lift my head.
I tighten my body.
The leaf is shaking wrong.
I head slowly for the underside.
I have nothing to fight with.
I spin silk and hang by it.
Shake again and I fall.
I watch your fingers.
This is not a safe place.

lines.zh: 你踩的那片叶子，是我的。
lines.en: The leaf you stepped on is mine.
Move, and I curl up.
I move up the vein.
I am still far from the edge.
I spin one thread.
This thread can hold me.
Do not come any closer.
I watch you from beneath the leaf.

lines.zh: 我在计算掉下去的距离
lines.en: I am judging the drop.
I will wait a while more.
I rear up and butt you.
That is all I can do.
My head is hard, but not that hard.
I spin silk around your finger.

lines.zh: 君主蝶的毛虫，味道很冲。
lines.en: A monarch caterpillar tastes sharp.
Do not crush me.
I push with my whole body.
This is all I know.
I have fallen off.
This is far from fair.
I poke out from under the leaf.
My bands show first.
I climb onto the leaf's top.
This leaf is mine.
I have found a good spot.
One more bite mark on the leaf.
I stretch my head to look around.
I spin silk to anchor myself.
The wind rocks the leaf.
I hug the vein.
The leaf scorches, and so do I.
I have fallen off the leaf.
A drop of water has swallowed me.
The whole leaf is blown away.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西擦过我的身体
lines.en: Something sharp grazed my body.
That light blinds me.

lines.zh: 没有叶子,我撑不了太久
lines.en: Without a leaf, I will not last long.
The thunder flattens me to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我抓不到任何一片叶子。
lines.en: There's no leaf left for me to grab.
